selectedFunctions.label: SATO buy caller-funded financial swap
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; no live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or complete workflow assurance. Independent grants, policy, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory.

Ethereum nonproxy SatoSwapRouter buy/sell only. Current official frontend selects ETH/SATO fee 3000, tickSpacing 60, hook 0x0000f07d2b5f1ddf3244b8780f972f306efd2888 through immutable Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90. Router accepts a PoolKey and does NOT itself force this key; these are typed financial pool/asset/hook fields, not arbitrary executable bytes. Other pool keys are not evidence of SATO curve behavior.

Buy spends msg.value in native ETH wei; sell pulls satoIn from msg.sender under an already-existing token allowance and requires zero native value. Recipient receives output; swapper is caller-supplied cooldown identity, not payer authorization. Caller must supply the intended identity; the contract does not enforce swapper=caller or recipient. No approvals, permits, hook callbacks or opaque unlockCallback calls admitted.

Curve SATO uses 18 decimals; ETH uses wei. Hook charges floor(amount*30/10000), 0.3%, on ETH input or gross ETH redemption. Fees accrue in hook with no withdrawal method. PRBMath fixed-point exp/log, floor ratios and fair-supply correction create rounding and economic spread; not a fixed price or peg.

Exact input only: buy has 5 ETH per-call maximum. Neither router method provides minimum output or deadline; price movement and value loss are possible. Sell applies lastBuyBlock cooldown to supplied swapper and burns SATO against hook ETH inventory. No promised backing or payout; insufficient reserves or token/manager failure revert.

Hook forbids all LP additions; no LP deposit/withdrawal capabilities exist here. At the observed reads selfDeprecated=false and poolInitialized=true. Reaching 99% fair-supply threshold irreversibly disables future curve buys, including after later burns; not a current retirement finding. Genesis first-100-block entropy window is closed. No admin, pause or upgrade path in router/hook source; dependency runtime not independently attested.

devdoc.title: SatoHook

BuyTooLarge().notice: Reverts when the buyer's ETH input exceeds MAX_BUY_WEI.

CooldownActive().notice: Reverts when a sell occurs within COOLDOWN_BLOCKS of the seller's last buy.

ExactOutputUnsupported().notice: Reverts when the swap is exact-output (only exact-input is supported).

InsufficientEthReserves().notice: Reverts when the inverse curve would require more ETH than the hook holds.

InvalidPool().notice: Reverts when the pool key does not match the configured ETH/SATO/POOL_FEE pair.

InverseDomainError().notice: Reverts when the curve ratio collapses to a non-positive log argument.

LiquidityAdditionsForbidden().notice: Reverts when an attempt is made to add liquidity directly to the pool.

MissingSwapperInHookData().notice: Reverts when `hookData` does not encode an address as the swapper identity.

NotPoolManager().notice: Reverts when a non-PoolManager caller invokes a hook entrypoint.

PRBMath_UD60x18_Exp2_InputTooBig(uint256.notice: Thrown when taking the binary exponent of a base greater than 192e18.

PRBMath_UD60x18_Exp_InputTooBig(uint256).notice: Thrown when taking the natural exponent of a base greater than 133_084258667509499441.

PRBMath_UD60x18_Log_InputTooSmall(uint25.notice: Thrown when taking the logarithm of a number less than UNIT.

SelfDeprecatedNoBuys().notice: Reverts when buys are attempted after self-deprecation.

SellExceedsSupply().notice: Reverts on invalid sell amount (more than circulating supply).

COOLDOWN_BLOCKS().notice: Number of blocks of cooldown between a wallet's last buy and its first sell.

ENTROPY_BLOCKS().notice: Number of blocks during which buys receive an entropy multiplier.

EXHAUSTION_THRESHOLD_NUMERATOR().notice: Numerator of the self-deprecation threshold (99/100 of K_SUPPLY).

GENESIS_BLOCK().notice: The block at which this hook was deployed.

GENESIS_HASH().notice: The hash of the block immediately preceding this hook's deployment.

K_SUPPLY().notice: Asymptotic supply cap of the curve.

MAX_BUY_WEI().notice: Maximum ETH input on a single buy.

afterInitialize(address,(address,address.notice: Unused. Required to satisfy the IHooks interface even though this hook does not         declare permission for it; the V4 manager will never invoke it for this address.

beforeInitialize(address,(address,addres.notice: Pool-init guard. The pool must be ETH/SATO with the configured fee and this hook.

beforeSwap(address,(address,address,uint.notice: Core trading entrypoint. Handles buys (ETH→SATO) and sells (SATO→ETH) via the         bonding curve, with no AMM liquidity ever present in the pool.

constructor.notice: Construct the hook. Validates that the deployment address has the correct         hook-permission bits encoded in its lowest 14 bits.

curveReserveEth().notice: The ETH balance of this contract, less the accumulated fees.         This is the pool of ETH that backs the inverse curve for sells.

ethCum().notice: Cumulative fair-curve ETH (after fees) that has flowed through the curve. Buys add, sells subtract.

feesAccrued().notice: Cumulative LP fee revenue (ETH) skimmed by the hook.

getHookPermissions().notice: Hook permissions declared for this contract. Mirrored against the address bits.

lastBuyBlock(address).notice: The block of each address's last buy. Used by the same-block cooldown on sells.

selfDeprecated().notice: Whether the curve has irreversibly entered self-deprecation. After this, no more buys.

BuyTooLarge().notice: Reverts when the buyer's ETH input exceeds MAX_BUY_WEI.

InvalidPool().notice: Reverts when the pool key does not match the configured ETH/SATO/POOL_FEE pair.

CooldownActive().notice: Reverts when a sell occurs within COOLDOWN_BLOCKS of the seller's last buy.

NotPoolManager().notice: Reverts when a non-PoolManager caller invokes a hook entrypoint.

SellExceedsSupply().notice: Reverts on invalid sell amount (more than circulating supply).

InverseDomainError().notice: Reverts when the curve ratio collapses to a non-positive log argument.

SelfDeprecatedNoBuys().notice: Reverts when buys are attempted after self-deprecation.

ExactOutputUnsupported().notice: Reverts when the swap is exact-output (only exact-input is supported).

InsufficientEthReserves().notice: Reverts when the inverse curve would require more ETH than the hook holds.

MissingSwapperInHookData().notice: Reverts when `hookData` does not encode an address as the swapper identity.

LiquidityAdditionsForbidden().notice: Reverts when an attempt is made to add liquidity directly to the pool.

PRBMath_UD60x18_Exp_InputTooBig(uint256).notice: Thrown when taking the natural exponent of a base greater than 133_084258667509499441.

PRBMath_UD60x18_Exp2_InputTooBig(uint256.notice: Thrown when taking the binary exponent of a base greater than 192e18.

PRBMath_UD60x18_Log_InputTooSmall(uint25.notice: Thrown when taking the logarithm of a number less than UNIT.

userdoc.notice: The Uniswap V4 hook that mints sato exclusively through a bonding curve.         Buys mint SATO via the forward curve; sells burn SATO via the inverse curve,         priced against accumulated ETH reserves held by this contract.

ethCum().notice: Cumulative fair-curve ETH (after fees) that has flowed through the curve. Buys add, sells subtract.

K_SUPPLY().notice: Asymptotic supply cap of the curve.

constructor.notice: Construct the hook. Validates that the deployment address has the correct         hook-permission bits encoded in its lowest 14 bits.

philosophy().notice: Decode the manifesto into a UTF-8 string by concatenating the eight bytes32 words         and trimming trailing null bytes.

MAX_BUY_WEI().notice: Maximum ETH input on a single buy.

feesAccrued().notice: Cumulative LP fee revenue (ETH) skimmed by the hook.

GENESIS_HASH().notice: The hash of the block immediately preceding this hook's deployment.

GENESIS_BLOCK().notice: The block at which this hook was deployed.

ENTROPY_BLOCKS().notice: Number of blocks during which buys receive an entropy multiplier.

selfDeprecated().notice: Whether the curve has irreversibly entered self-deprecation. After this, no more buys.

COOLDOWN_BLOCKS().notice: Number of blocks of cooldown between a wallet's last buy and its first sell.

curveReserveEth().notice: The ETH balance of this contract, less the accumulated fees.         This is the pool of ETH that backs the inverse curve for sells.

poolInitialized().notice: Whether the pool has been initialized (gates buys to the post-init flow).

totalMintedFair().notice: Fair-curve circulating supply: tokens that map onto `ethCum` via the forward curve.         This is what the inverse curve uses to price sells. Differs from `SATO_TOKEN.totalSupply()`         when entropy multipliers have minted bonus tokens.

getHookPermissions().notice: Hook permissions declared for this contract. Mirrored against the address bits.

lastBuyBlock(address).notice: The block of each address's last buy. Used by the same-block cooldown on sells.

EXHAUSTION_THRESHOLD_NUMERATOR().notice: Numerator of the self-deprecation threshold (99/100 of K_SUPPLY).

beforeInitialize(address,(address,addres.notice: Pool-init guard. The pool must be ETH/SATO with the configured fee and this hook.

afterInitialize(address,(address,address.notice: Unused. Required to satisfy the IHooks interface even though this hook does not         declare permission for it; the V4 manager will never invoke it for this address.

beforeSwap(address,(address,address,uint.notice: Core trading entrypoint. Handles buys (ETH→SATO) and sells (SATO→ETH) via the         bonding curve, with no AMM liquidity ever present in the pool.

devdoc.title: SatoHook
devdoc.details: See implementation note at the top of this file.

params.manifesto: The 8x32-byte manifesto string, padded with trailing zeros.
params.satoToken: The sato ERC-20 token (this hook will be set as its sole minter).

returns._0: The manifesto, exactly as it was at construction.
The 14-bool struct with permissions set as: beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity,         beforeSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta = true; all others = false.
The hook selector if accepted; otherwise reverts.

params.hookData: abi.encode(address) of the actual swapper (cooldowns track this address).

beforeSwap(address,(address,address,uint.details: Routers must pre-settle the input currency to the PoolManager prior to calling         swap (i.e., already hold a positive delta in the input currency in the manager).

returns.delta: The BeforeSwapDelta cancelling the AMM-routed portion of the swap and               accounting the hook's input/output deltas for end-of-unlock netting.
returns.lpFeeOverride: Always zero; this hook does not override LP fees dynamically.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is zero by default. This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the value of tokens owned by `account`.

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the default value returned by this function, unless it's overridden. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

totalSupply().details: Returns the value of tokens in existence.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Skips emitting an {Approval} event indicating an allowance update. This is not required by the ERC. See {xref-ERC20-_approve-address-address-uint256-bool-}[_approve]. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

userdoc.notice: Plain ERC-20 with one designated minter that is locked in once and cannot be changed.         No owner. No pause. No blacklist. No fee logic. No upgrade path.

minter().notice: The designated minter (the SatoHook). Locked once `setMinter` is called.

DEPLOYER().notice: The address that deployed this contract (only entity allowed to set the minter once).

constructor.notice: Construct the token. No constructor arguments.

GENESIS_HASH().notice: The hash of the block immediately preceding deployment. Burned into bytecode.

GENESIS_BLOCK().notice: The block at which this contract was deployed.

setMinter(address).notice: Set the minter exactly once, then lock forever.

burn(address,uint256).notice: Burn SATO held by `from`. Callable only by the locked-in minter (the hook),         used to retire tokens during sells settled against the inverse curve.

mint(address,uint256).notice: Mint SATO. Callable only by the locked-in minter.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the default value returned by this function, unless it's overridden. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

totalSupply().details: Returns the value of tokens in existence.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the value of tokens owned by `account`.

params.newMinter: The address (the SatoHook) that will be the sole entity allowed to mint.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is zero by default. This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Skips emitting an {Approval} event indicating an allowance update. This is not required by the ERC. See {xref-ERC20-_approve-address-address-uint256-bool-}[_approve]. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.
